note: native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
activity bar and status bar icons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
editor chrome -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: tab close/split/more controls; subtracts breadcrumbs (user file paths), editor instance (user file content), and tab headers (user file names)

status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: remote kind, problem counts, port counts, notification counts, editor mode (JSON), EOL, encoding, indentation, selection, screen reader mode; subtracts language status which may contain extension-injected text
